doc.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017

chapter: Old styles, big bands and rhythm sections
title: Bringing old big band charts to the Institute band
summary: He pushed old charts for the band, which rebelled, but he argues they swing if played right.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: That’s what I started to gather, and partly why I wanted to talk to you.

And they rebelled. They go, “We can’t keep playing this old stuff, we’ve got to play something more modern era.” But see the reason why I brought the old stuff into the band was because I thought okay, our level of expertise, this is probably about all we can handle comfortably. Plus, if you play them right, they swing on their own man. I mean they sound good, even today they sound good, if you play it right and you’ve got the right feeling behind it and you hit the notes.
